parameters.query: SELECT settings FROM users WHERE tg_id = $1;

WITH ensure_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (tg_id) VALUES ($1)
  ON CONFLICT (tg_id) DO NOTHING
)
INSERT INTO user_order_status (user_tg_id, order_id, status, note, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
ON CONFLICT (user_tg_id, order_id)
DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, note = EXCLUDED.note, updated_at = now()
RETURNING order_id, status, note;
